title: Fix agora-interaction-worker container healthcheck timing out under 5s deadline
summary: Resolved agora-interaction-worker healthcheck timeout failure during official release 37571305114 root rollout. Preserved reviewed heartbeat healthcheck from #6272 ensuring fast stdlib-only liveness probe within the 5s deadline while deferring runtime stores. Wired canonical persona registry write owner into create_read_surface_ports() in services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/persona_client.py, replacing silent empty fallback with fail-closed behavior on missing or unavailable Persona service. Mapped PERSONA_URL, PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN, PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_ACTOR_ID and persona service dependency in docker-compose.yml. Verified with 30 focused tests across worker launcher, persona client, runtime wiring, and compose tenant contracts.

root_cause_analysis.failure_signature: Repeated healthExit -1 Health check exceeded timeout 5s
mechanism: services/control-plane/bff/Dockerfile sets ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, forcing full uncached compilation of imported Python modules on every CLI healthcheck invocation.

scripts/run_agora_interaction_worker.py eagerly imported runtime stores (ProposalStore, InteractionLifecycleStore, PostgresWorkshopStore, MemoryResearchPlanStore, etc.) before argument parsing, consuming >3.0s CPU time which ballooned to 14.01s elapsed time under container host load (load average 16-21).
docker-compose.yml agora-interaction-worker omitted PERSONA_URL and PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN, leaving the container worker unconfigured for canonical Persona owner HTTP communications.

services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/persona_client.py called create_read_surface_ports() without persona_registry_store, defaulting to None and falling back to an empty list ([]) when unconfigured, instead of failing closed.

changes: Preserved reviewed heartbeat healthcheck (check_heartbeat()) executing stdlib-only in <0.1s well under the 5s Compose timeout limit.
Deferred heavy runtime store imports into main() execution after healthcheck parsing.
Startup retains build_canonical_persona_client() initialization ensuring worker fails closed if dependencies cannot be constructed.
Wired create_persona_registry_write_owner() into create_read_surface_ports() to provide genuine canonical store backing for PersonaReadPort without silent empty fallbacks.
Preserved protocol conformance and existing read surface contract compatibility.

Added PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN: ${PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN:-pantheon-local-persona-service-token} and PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_ACTOR_ID: operator-bff to agora-interaction-worker environment.
Added persona dependency (condition: service_healthy, required: false) to agora-interaction-worker depends_on.
Added contract tests verifying agora-interaction-worker default PERSONA_URL, service token, and actor id resolution.
Added contract tests verifying environment variable overrides for PERSONA_URL and service token.
Added contract test verifying agora-interaction-worker depends_on includes persona.
Added cold-start healthcheck test under 5s deadline with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
Added tests verifying missing or stale heartbeat fails closed.
Added probe test verifying healthcheck does not import runtime stores.
Added worker --once initialization test with mock Persona server.
Added canonical persona client wiring and fail-closed surface status tests.

1_reproduce_cold_start_cost.evidence: Eager imports consumed 3.01s CPU / 14.01s elapsed before repair. Deferring runtime-only stores and using stdlib heartbeat probe reduced healthcheck execution to <0.1s elapsed.

2_preserve_canonical_persona_config_and_.evidence: Wiring persona_registry_store=create_persona_registry_write_owner() eliminated empty fallback. Unconfigured or unavailable Persona dependency reports surface unavailable and fails closed.

3_separate_runtime_only_work_without_syn.evidence: Healthcheck probe actively checks running loop heartbeat file touched during loop ticks. No synthetic 0 exit code without live running worker.

4_subprocess_and_cold_start_tests.evidence: Comprehensive test suites in scripts/test_run_agora_interaction_worker.py, services/control-plane/bff/agora/interaction/test_persona_client.py, services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_agora_interaction_worker_runtime_wiring.py, and scripts/test_worker_tenant_compose_contract.py pass completely.

5_no_timeout_inflation_or_hosted_mutatio.evidence: Healthcheck timeout remains strictly 5s. No runtime data or hosted state mutated.

6_independent_exact_head_review.evidence: Pending fresh exact-head independent review by Claude on PR #6258 following rebase on current dev and Compose Persona wiring addition.
